resets.asserted_meaning: Sets no_ones to zero; the integer bit index is not reset.

ports.name: i_a
ports.role: 16-bit vector whose bits are examined in successive cycles by the integer index.

ports.name: no_ones
ports.role: Four-bit running sum of examined input bits that are 1, until integer index reaches 16.

declared_unknowns.description: The output register is not initialized in RTL and remains unknown until a rising edge with reset asserted; the integer index initializes to zero, increments even during reset, and is never reset.

An X-valued sampled input bit makes the RTL arithmetic result unknown; a directed X sample verifies propagation. The accumulator stops updating when the index is no longer less than 16. Only index values 0 through 16 are exercised; signed integer overflow and out-of-range indexing are not tested.
Clock and reset SystemC ports use bool and are modeled only for binary 0/1 levels; X/Z on clock or reset is outside the modeled verification scope.
